item.title: The EU DPP Registry's API and battery data model are out: what to build before February 2027
item.author: consulting@circulartechforum.de (Yvo Hunink de Paiva)
item.description: Battery passports must be registered from 18 February 2027. The Commission's 30 October 2026 technical package for the EU DPP Registry adds a registration API, two authentication profiles and a semantic model for batteries. What to build now.
